definitions.explanation: The green variety of the shiso (perilla) plant, widely used as a garnish and flavoring in Japanese cuisine. Has a distinctive fresh, slightly minty aroma.

examples.japanese: ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{青|あお}じそ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}えた→添える：13315_soeru⟧。
examples.english: I garnished the sashimi with green shiso.

examples.japanese: {青|あお}じそ⟦ドレッシング→ドレッシング：11126_doresshingu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。

⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衣|ころも}→衣：14162_koromo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{青|あお}じそ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}いて→巻く：02418_maku⟧⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}くて→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{食欲|しょくよく}をそそる→食欲をそそる：21304_shokuyokuwososoru⟧。
examples.english: If you wrap green shiso in tempura batter and fry it, the aroma is wonderful and whets the appetite.

notes:
Also called ⟦{大葉|おおば}→大葉：17713_ooba⟧ in the Kansai region and in supermarkets. The green variety is used as a garnish and flavoring, while the red variety (⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧じそ) is used mainly for ⟦{梅干|うめぼ}し→梅干し：13110_umeboshi⟧ (pickled plums) and juices.
